description: Ministry of Roads & Highways -  Pelawatta - Akurugoda -  Pothuarawa Road as National Highway under National Throughfares Act
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of a specific road as a National Highway under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It is an Order issued by the Minister, which constitutes a regulatory action and the exercise of statutory powers. The content focuses on the legal and regulatory framework for designating national infrastructure, not on government personnel changes, structural administration, or any of the other specialized categories. Therefore, it is classified as a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
